description: Opens a support case so a person at 4fillment replies by e-mail. Returns a case reference and an access token. Takes the reply e-mail address, a category, a summary, and optional order, SKU, shipment or tracking numbers.

category.description: shipping_at_risk or warehouse_stopped for same-day problems; receiving_or_stock, lost_or_damaged or stuck_shipment for stock and shipments; billing, integration, setup or general otherwise.

email.description: The e-mail address for the reply from a person at 4fillment.

refs.description: Order, SKU, shipment or tracking numbers, if the user has them.

summary.description: What the user needs, in their words, and what was already tried. No passwords or payment details.

name: ask_a_person
title: Ask a person
